selection_rule: Before any seed 73-82 physics, use only fixed course-catalog initial state: even lane, incoming ball_vx <0, 2.0 <= ball_x <=2.55 m and -0.09<=ball_y<=-0.02 m. No physics outcome used to choose cases.
procedure: Each of 17 preregistered courses gets independent parent+actor baseline and sealed guarded-online candidate, four A6000 workers, one G1 and one ball per process. Audit source, assets, parent, commands, physical contacts and swing action; no batched causal labels.
challenge_gate: All 13 difficulty cases must activate the bounded candidate; baseline must have at least two >4 m out-of-play cases to make rescue measurable; candidate must rescue at least two, add at least three high-quality shots, keep total clean-foot-only contacts no lower, add no new out-of-play and improve mean measured reward by at least 0.5.
protection_gate: All four positive-side controls must issue zero lateral command and exactly preserve baseline first-contact body, clean/high-quality classification, and 60-frame ball displacement within 0.01 m; no pelvis <0.65 m.
interpretation: Targeted mechanism pressure test only, not a random-population generalization or team-match promotion. Any failure rejects this mechanism; even a pass requires a later broad independent exam and multiplayer chain integration.
